# 0044: Governed spawn checks preserve required controls

Status: accepted
Type: architecture
Date: 2026-10-24

## Context

HC8 authenticates control data and HMT computes private current-boundary values,
but existing tokenomics hooks consume neither and have no sampling seam. They
deliberately fail open on faults and release repeated economic denials. Native
authentication and installed interception remain unqualified. The full governed
command objective is incomplete, not blocked solely by hosted startup refusal.

0022 still requires model/effort/tier/fork checks for every applicable spawn. No
evidence justifies sampling that entire decision or changing legacy defaults.
Two live consultation requests carrying critic/deep markers were classified as
workers by the installed hook; the cause is unconfirmed. Do not alter global hooks
or treat that observation as proof that the native payload changed.

## Decision

Admit [HSE](../../designs/harness-spawn-economics.md) under W1's existing budget:
strict pure agent-hooks evaluation plus a private HC8/HMT receiver integration.
Keep required spawn checks at 100%. Only optional advice-match observations use
governed sampling. No native consent, model, sampled result or silent output waives
a required denial. Legacy hook fault/fallback/denial-loop semantics stay unchanged.

Bind exact policy and evaluator bytes through the protected controller, stable
advice sampling through a private key and delivered event/site, and every child
reply to one current private context. Revalidate after the bounded child. Public
operator reports expose closed outcomes/counters, never effective controls or an
allow credential. Native output is deny or silence, never rewriting a request.

Reuse parsePolicy/decideSpawn. A private internal wire package serves the two actual
commands; it is not a new shared foundation or public rule engine. Preserve native
Claude fork/resume and Codex context-fork/model/effort semantics explicitly.
No passive collection, journal, new per-spawn nudge, daemon, installation or third
incubation. Actual host delivery/failure behavior remains a separate qualification.

## Rejected alternatives

- Sample the complete spawn decision: contradicts 0022 and can waive required rules.
  Wins if: 0022 is explicitly reopened with independently measured evidence.
- Call the legacy hook and interpret empty stdout as safe: internal faults and the
  denial-loop breaker can also be silent. Wins if: never as a required evaluator.
- Public maintenance report as an allow token: has no authenticated recipient or
  current effect binding. Wins if: never under HMT.
- Duplicate the spawn rule engine or pre-build a central broker: unnecessary policy
  drift/coupling. Wins if: measured consumers establish a separately admitted need.
- Release arbitrary policy/advice text or raw hook diagnostics: unnecessary disclosure.
  Wins if: a separately scoped public-guidance contract defines the exact release.

## Revisit when

A required check is skipped or released, the native payload loses a used field,
policy/recipient drift passes, a sampling retry changes the same event's draw,
privacy or latency bars fail, actual host behavior differs, two consumers require
public extraction, or 2026-11-21/next release arrives. GT11/GT9..10 and the full
goal remain open until their native and adoption evidence exists.
